title: Hotels Near MedPark Hospital, Bangkok 2026 — 7 Closest Stays + Booking Links | ThailandAddict
metaDesc: The 7 closest hotels to MedPark Hospital in Bangkok — each with the real walking or driving distance to MedPark, what it's best for, approximate starting prices and booking links. Made for patients and their families.
ogDesc: The 7 closest stays to MedPark, with real distances and prices.
intro: MedPark is a newer private hospital popular with international and longer-stay medical patients, so the recurring question is simply: where do you stay to get to and from treatment easily? The hospital sits in the Rama IV–Khlong Toei office belt, which mixes budget day-rate rooms right by the MRT with serviced apartments that suit week-long stays. We've kept the list to places you can genuinely walk to or reach in a short drive, with the real distance spelled out so the call is easy.

blocks.html: Short answer: MedPark sits on Rama IV inside The PARQ, right by Khlong Toei MRT (Exit 2, a 200 m walk) and also reachable on foot through the QSNCC MRT concourse. If you want to genuinely walk to the hospital, pick Modena by Fraser inside the FYI Center tower (5-min walk, and it runs a shuttle to MedPark). On a tighter budget, Seekers Finders Rama IV shares the same Khlong Toei MRT stop. Sukhumvit/Phrom Phong hotels are an 8–12 minute drive away.

blocks.text: Hotels near MedPark, by distance & budget

items.name: Seekers Finders Rama IV Hotel, SureStay Collection by Best Western
items.meta: 📍 10-min walk (700 m) or one MRT stop to MedPark · ★ 3-star · Best for: Patient families · budget · by Khlong Toei MRT · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: On Rama IV just 300 m from Khlong Toei MRT — the same station you use for MedPark. You can stroll along the road in about 10 minutes or hop one MRT stop. Rooms are a roomy 25 sqm with a fridge and microwave, which suits relatives keeping vigil for several days without paying a premium. There's a rooftop pool and bar to decompress.

items.name: Citadines Sukhumvit 8 Bangkok
items.meta: 📍 8-min drive (1.8 km) to MedPark · ★ 4-star · Best for: Longer stays · in-room kitchen · self-catering · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A serviced apartment near the mouth of Sukhumvit Soi 8, with a kitchenette and fridge in each unit — handy for longer treatments when you want to heat your own food or stick to a doctor's diet. It's about an 8-minute drive to MedPark. There's a rooftop pool and gym, and the nightly rate is good value for a kitchen room in this area.

items.name: Modena by Fraser Bangkok
items.meta: 📍 5-min walk (450 m) · shuttle to MedPark to MedPark · ★ 4-star · Best for: Walk to the hospital · limited mobility · longer stays · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: The strongest pick if you'll walk to and from MedPark daily. It's inside the FYI Center tower by QSNCC MRT, roughly a 5-minute walk to the hospital, and the property even runs a shuttle that drops at MedPark. As a serviced apartment with a kitchenette, it works for both patients who can't manage long walks and families settling in for a week.

items.name: Centre Point Sukhumvit 10
items.meta: 📍 6-min drive (1.4 km) to MedPark · ★ 4-star · Best for: Families · suites · near Benjakitti Park · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A popular suite-style hotel off Sukhumvit Soi 10, with various suite sizes that suit families travelling together. It's about a 6-minute drive to MedPark — the hotel itself cites a 5-minute drive. Benjakitti Park is close by for a calming walk, and it's near Asok BTS and Sukhumvit MRT.

items.name: Carlton Hotel Bangkok Sukhumvit
items.meta: 📍 10-min drive (2.5 km) to MedPark · ★ 5-star · Best for: High-floor views · full facilities · Asok–Phrom Phong · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A high-rise on Sukhumvit between Asok and Phrom Phong BTS, with upper-floor rooms that pull in city views, a sky pool, a spa and several restaurants. The hotel cites a 12-minute drive (2.5 km) to the international hospital nearby. A good fit if you want full five-star comfort with a short drive to treatment.

items.name: DoubleTree by Hilton Sukhumvit Bangkok
items.meta: 📍 10-min drive (2.6 km) to MedPark · ★ 5-star · Best for: Near Phrom Phong/Emporium · shopping · Hilton service · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: On Sukhumvit Soi 26 next to the Emporium mall, about a 3-minute walk to Phrom Phong BTS and roughly a 10-minute drive to MedPark. It suits anyone who wants easy shopping and dining after hospital visits, with a pool, a poolside bar and dependable Hilton service.

items.name: Grande Centre Point Lumphini
items.meta: 📍 7-min drive (1.5 km) along Rama IV to MedPark · ★ 5-star · Best for: Upscale stay · resort facilities · same road as MedPark · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A newer five-star on Rama IV near Lumphini MRT — the same road as MedPark, about a 7-minute drive away. The draw is its stacked facilities: pool, tennis court, gym and generously sized rooms. A comfortable base for those who want to relax between treatments and aren't watching the budget.

faq.q: Which hotel can I actually walk to MedPark from, without a taxi?
faq.a: Modena by Fraser Bangkok is the closest on foot — it's inside the FYI Center tower next to MedPark, about a 5-minute walk (450 m), and it runs a shuttle that drops at the hospital. Seekers Finders Rama IV is about a 10-minute walk along Rama IV, or one MRT stop from Khlong Toei.

faq.q: How do I get from my hotel to MedPark by MRT?
faq.a: MedPark sits between Khlong Toei MRT (Exit 2, a 200 m walk) and Queen Sirikit National Convention Centre MRT (a 5-minute walk through The PARQ building). Hotels near those two stations, like Seekers Finders or Modena, make the round trip on the MRT easy and let you skip the road traffic.

faq.q: For a week-long stay during treatment, what should I pick?
faq.a: A serviced apartment with an in-room kitchen is usually better value and more practical — for example Modena by Fraser (walkable to the hospital) or Citadines Sukhumvit 8 (kitchenette for self-catering). Both have a fridge and cooking corner to reheat meals or follow a doctor's diet, and weekly rates often beat booking night by night.
